skill.summary: Connect 8,000+ apps via Zapier MCP. Includes full UI integration for Clawdbot Gateway dashboard. Use when setting up Zapier integration, connecting apps, or...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Zapier MCP integration for Clawdbot.
- Connect 8,000+ apps through a simple Zapier MCP URL—no OAuth or complex setup required.
- Full dashboard UI: configure, test, and browse all available Zapier tools in Clawdbot.
- Tools can be called via mcporter using natural-language instructions.
- Automated grouping and browsing of tools by app; supports live tool status and connection testing.
- Reference backend and UI code included for custom integrations.
